how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply online for the Federal Bank Sales Officer - Corporate Salary post by following these steps:
Access Talent Connect, Federal Bank's job portal, through the Careers page of the Bank's website.
Create your profile in Talent Connect and select "Retail Liabilities" as your preferred Work Domain / Vertical.
If you are already registered on Talent Connect, update your profile and select "Retail Liabilities" as your preferred Work Domain / Vertical.
Candidates shortlisted during the Application Screening round will be contacted for the subsequent stages of the selection process.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted only through Talent Connect, Federal Bank's official job portal. Candidates must select "Retail Liabilities" as their preferred Work Domain / Vertical while registering or updating their profile. Only candidates shortlisted in the Application Screening round will be contacted for the Personal Interview. Candidates should keep an updated CV ready before applying. Applications must be submitted on or before 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is Federal Bank Sales Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by The Federal Bank Limited to hire Sales Officers for its Corporate Salary vertical under Retail Liabilities, open to experienced graduates.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Federal Bank Sales Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Federal Bank Sales Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is work experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in the BFSI sector.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Federal Bank Sales Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years; candidates should be born on or after 01/08/1991. A lower age limit is not specified.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Federal Bank Sales Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through Talent Connect, accessed via the Careers page of Federal Bank's website, by selecting "Retail Liabilities" as their preferred vertical and uploading their CV.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Federal Bank Sales Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through Application Screening followed by a Personal Interview.
